notes: Nemotron-3-Nano-4B_int8.litertlm as on the main branch of litert-community/Nemotron-3-Nano-4B since 2026-10-14 (file commit b4200576): a metadata-only re-pack of the previous file (sha256 feefdcd5...). The previous chat template rendered an assistant turn by its position (the latest one with its full think block, earlier ones as `<think></think>`), so on litert-lm 0.18.0, which hands the template each reply's reasoning_content, a second message with thinking on failed the Conversation's prefix check (`INTERNAL: The new rendered template string does not start with the previous rendered template string`; LiteRT-LM#3166 describes the check). The new template renders every assistant history turn as `<think></think>` plus the answer, the form the previous one used once a newer user turn followed; the TFLite, tokenizer and executor-metadata sections are byte-identical to the previous file, the container header is 1.7.0 (written by the 0.18 builder). Function gates, not throughput measurements. The previous file on the same harnesses the same day: the three-turn script with thinking unset returned turn 1 and failed turn 2 (the runtime's status `INTERNAL: The new rendered template string does not start with the previous rendered template string`); the 8-question gate scored 8/8 on the CPU and 8/8 on the GPU with --cache no, with the same answers as this file, and its GPU answer broke with the default cache in the same way.
quantization: dynamic int8 (linears + embedding; convolutions and the selective scan stay float), fp32 activations declared, reduced 7-signature prefill ladder
